Fig. 9. RTVPNet framework. RTVPNet contains three basic tasks: Visual Grounding, Vision Question Answering, and Object Detection. (a) Domain Projection includes expert model pre-training, domain-aware projection, and dynamic expert update. The convergence speed of the expert CNN pre-trained in industrial scenarios can provide domain migration for Mobile-SAM quickly. (b) Refined Visual Prompt to establish a sample selection strategy and generate refined visual prompts to promote the understanding of specific tasks in industrial scenarios. (c) Text-Visual Mutual refines visual features in multi-scale feature through text-guided interaction of visual features. (d) Visual-Text Mutual integrates image channels and spatial dimensions into similar regions of text, which helps to align and enhance the semantics of image and text.
